title: attention 计算用 KV cache：历史长度即缓存行数
expected_output:
attention 分数(历史长度=缓存行数): 3
分数: [0.08, 0.09, 0.16]
减最大值后的 logits: [-0.08, -0.07, 0.0]
code:
def matmul_vec(q, M):
    return [sum(q[k]*M[r][k] for k in range(len(q))) for r in range(len(M))]

K_cache = [[0.1,0.2],[0.3,0.1],[0.2,0.4]]
V_cache = [[1.0,0.0],[0.0,1.0],[0.5,0.5]]
q = [0.2, 0.3]
scores = matmul_vec(q, K_cache)
print("attention 分数(历史长度=缓存行数):", len(scores))
print("分数:", [round(s,3) for s in scores])
mx = max(scores)
w = [s - mx for s in scores]
print("减最大值后的 logits:", [round(x,3) for x in w])
